## Why

The claim sink's vocabulary was open: `PgClaimSink` auto-registered any
unknown `predicate_id` into `vocab_predicate` with generic datatype,
definition, volatility, and resolution-strategy defaults no resolver
could adjudicate — synthetic certainty at the write seam. An
unregistered predicate or genre now quarantines with the full record as
payload; nothing lands, nothing is minted.

## What ships

- **Closed sink** (`db/src/db/claim_sink.py`, `db/src/db/assertion.py`):
  predicate claims gate on `vocab_predicate`; `evidence_genre` gates on
  the new `vocab_artifact_genre` table; rejections quarantine with
  `unknown_predicate`/`unknown_genre` and the untouched payload.
  `register_vocabulary` now validates ids (never mints). Qualifier ids
  resolve through the same closed registry (`unknown_qualifier`).
- **Registry** (`ontology/vocab/predicates.yaml`): 280 registered
  predicates — the six measured-missing (`installation_date`,
  `last_checked`, `upstream_ref`, `portal_stated_permitted_use`,
  `deployed`, `retention_window_observed`), the connector-allowlist set,
  the §12.3 integration edges (`requests_data_from`,
  `distributes_list_to`, `authorizes`, `replaced_by`, `succeeds`), the
  connector-stamped ids (`atlas_category_retired`,
  `osm_element_deleted`, plus the reserved-but-never-emitted
  `deployment_ended`/`physical_removed_from_street`), `mfa_required`,
  `operator_absent`, `observed_via`, `live_stream_permitted_to`,
  `retention_days`, `third_party_integration` — every row with real
  datatype/cardinality/SKOS IRI/volatility/half-life/strategy and a full
  (genre × predicate) directness row.
- **Genre conformance:** Atlas method labels map to closed registry
  genres (`atlas_vocab.toml` `artifact_genre`), the upstream label kept
  as `atlas_method` provenance with `evidence_genre_granularity_loss`
  for unmapped/blank components; OSM claims stamp `osm_node_set`; Eyes
  on Flock claims stamp `portal_snapshot` — never the `connector_run`
  fallback.
- **Mobility** (`osm_tag_vocab.toml`): `mobile`→`redeployable`,
  `vehicle`→`vehicle_mounted`, `drone`→`airborne` — the unregistered
  `mobile` literal is gone (SIG-GEO-005); vocab_version bumped.
- **SKOS hygiene** (`technology.yaml`, `generate.py`): the 40
  non-family-prefixed slugs are `status: retired` + `superseded_by`
  (never deleted — SIG-ONTO-053), emitted under `retired/` IRIs with
  `owl:deprecated`; the reflexive `private-camera-integration` broader
  edge is removed; the generator now **fails** on any reflexive or
  cyclic `skos:broader` (technology + structural enums). Crosswalks,
  connector TOMLs, `ops/seed.py` and `build_tech.py` repointed at the
  family-prefixed successors.
- **Succession retirement** (`common.yaml`, `entities.yaml`):
  `SuccessionKind`, `Organization.succession`, `Organization.succession_kind`
  removed — `OrganizationRelationType` (SIG-IDENT-016/017/019) is the
  surviving temporal model.
- **Group-13:** `operator_absent` predicate + OSM emission (countable
  absence); `mfa_required` slot on `ConfigurationState`; the
  twelve-power-property carrier test; `us.le.rtcc` under
  `law_enforcement`; crosswalk `relation` + `lossy` made compulsory in
  test; `wikidata_vendor_links` QID→vendor block; the
  `ST_DWithin`/`::geography` lint.
- **Sqitch `closed_vocabulary`**: INSERT-only seed — `vocab_artifact_genre`
  (20 genres), `vocab_resolution_strategy` (5), `vocab_predicate`
  (280 registry rows, `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` — pre-existing
  auto-registered rows keep their values; correcting them is queued
  hosted work), `directness_matrix` (5,600 rows @ ruleset 1.0.0), and
  the `assertion_quarantine` reason CHECK widened for `unknown_genre`.
  Revert deletes only unreferenced rows (referenced registry rows are
  history, never rewritten). No UPDATE/DELETE anywhere.
- **SIG-ONTO-060 proposal**
  (`docs/governance/capability-scope-amendment-proposal.md`): the
  realised `capability.yaml` scope set (21 scopes; 15 of 45 slugs
  out-of-list) recorded with the drafted amendment text — a committed
  proposal for the operator, **not applied** (a closed-list relaxation
  needs operator words, G.7.5).
- **Tests:** `tests/connectors/test_vocabulary_conformance.py`
  (mechanical enumeration of every allowlist predicate, source-stamped
  predicate, emitted genre, and the mobility enum targets — plus two
  planted-violation tests proving the gate bites);
  `tests/ontology/test_p3514a_conformance.py` (the group-13 batch +
  retirement + SKOS hygiene); `tests/db/test_claim_sink.py` closed-
  vocabulary suite (unknown predicate/genre quarantine, payload-digest
  idempotency, qualifier gate, `register_vocabulary` validation);
  fixture-predicate seeding via the new
  `tests/db/conftest.py::register_vocab_predicate` helper across the
  sink suites that used to rely on auto-registration.

## Verification

- `make gen` — regenerated `ontology/generated` (committed).
- `make verify-gen` — clean diff at head.
- `make check` (with `SIG_GCP_PROJECT` sentinel) — lint, format, mypy
  (340 files), 8081-test suite: **all green** at head SHA.
- `make test-db` — **not run locally: no Docker daemon in this
  environment** (recorded as the run's deviation; CI's Docker leg is
  the verification surface for the closed-vocabulary sink tests and the
  `closed_vocabulary` migration).
